steps.tip: Laird sells fish at the end of the Auberdine pier, right where the hippogryph lands.
Return to Nessa sends you back to Rut'theran. Keep it for the Darnassus trip later in this pack.

steps.text: Talk to Caylais Moonfeather to make sure you have the Auberdine flight path
steps.tip: Forever adds a boat between Auberdine and Stormwind Harbor. It is an alternative if you would rather level in the Eastern Kingdoms after Teldrassil.

steps.text: Set your hearthstone at the Auberdine inn
steps.tip: Auberdine is your base for the whole zone; every loop here ends with a hearth back.
Wizbang stands in the inn. Pygmy Tide Crawlers line the beach right below Auberdine.
Gwennyth is on the pier. Her chain sends you to bones and beached animals up and down the coast; pick each one up as you pass it.
Forever bounty on the board outside the inn. Jai'vhanel is a named furbolg near Ameth'Aran.
Terenthis only wants you to find the Blackwood camp for now; you will kill furbolgs for him later.
Anaya's spirit is level 16. Take the quest now and kill her when you reach Ameth'Aran if you feel strong enough.
Thundris Windweaver is at the north end of Auberdine. Both quests point you to the ruins east and south of town.
Warriors: the Elunite crates and the Shade of Elura are in the sunken ship west of Auberdine. Watch your breath bar.

steps.text: Druids: use the Cenarion Moondust at the Moonkin Stone east of Auberdine and defeat Lunaclaw
steps.tip: Druids: Lunaclaw appears when you use the moondust. After the fight, talk to the Lunaclaw Spirit before you leave.
The crawlers walk the beach just below Auberdine. Pull them one at a time; they come back fast.
Buzzbox 827 is on the beach south of the pier. Each Buzzbox hands you the next one.
Darkshore Threshers swim just offshore. Fight them close to the beach so you can pull back to land.
Buzzbox 411 sits on the shore further north.
Moonstalker fangs come from the cats in the woods south of Auberdine; you pass them on the way to Ameth'Aran.
Asterion waits at the ruins of Bashal'Aran, east of the coast road.
Vile Sprites and Wild Grells fill the ruins around Asterion.
The Deth'ryll satyrs are on the east side of the ruins. One of them drops the seal.
The Ancient Flame is in Ameth'Aran to the south. You come back to Asterion on your way north later.
Use the trap near a Rabid Thistle Bear and lead it in. The bears roam the hills south-east of Auberdine.
The Mysterious Red Crystal is in a clearing on the hill east of the bears.
The Beached Sea Creature bones are on the beach south of Auberdine.
Back in Auberdine. Cleansing of the Infected asks for 20 Rabid Thistle Bears; kill them whenever they cross your path.
Fill the tube at the Auberdine moonwell, right in town.
The Skeletal Sea Turtle is on the sea floor west of Auberdine. Swim out, loot it, swim back.
Pour the water on the Red Crystal east of town; it gives you the next step on the spot.
Kill Rabid Thistle Bears on the hills between the crystal and Ameth'Aran.
steps.speed: Speedrun: the bears are good XP at this level. Finish the 20 as you pass through, do not hunt them down.

steps.tip: Moonstalkers prowl the woods south of the crystal.

steps.text: Scout the Blackwood furbolg camp south of Auberdine for How Big a Threat?
steps.tip: Just get close to the camp; you will come back to clear it.
Sentinel Tysha guards the road at the west edge of Ameth'Aran.
Another beached turtle lies on the beach west of Ameth'Aran.
The two tablets are inside the ruined buildings: one in the north half of Ameth'Aran, one in the south.
Cursed Highborne and Writhing Highborne drop the relics all over the ruins.
The Ancient Flame burns in the building at the south end of the ruins.
Anaya Dawnrunner walks with the other ghosts in the ruins. She is level 16, so pull her alone and keep your cooldowns.
Forever bounty: Jai'vhanel patrols with the furbolgs on the east side of the ruins.
One more Beached Sea Creature lies further down the coast.

steps.speed: Speedrun: hearth here; walking back gives nothing new.

steps.tip: Glynda takes both.
Tharnariun's Hope is the Den Mother, a level 18-19 bear. Keep it for the last northern loop.
Terenthis wants eight of each furbolg type. Do that on your way to the Grove of the Ancients.
A short breadcrumb from Terenthis to Thundris, who stands nearby.
The Tower of Althalaxx is in the far north-east, past the Cliffspring River.
Gorbold sends you to two shipwrecks off the coast north of Auberdine. Both lockboxes are underwater.
Barithras wants mushrooms from the cave by the Cliffspring Falls.
Balanced: one trip back for Nessa's reward and your class quests. Speedrun skips this unless you are a warrior or druid.

steps.text: Warriors and druids: fly to Rut'theran Village for your class quests

steps.tip: Nessa is at the fishing dock in Rut'theran.
Warriors: Elanaria is on the warrior terrace. Take the portal up from Rut'theran.
Smith Mathiel works on the Tradesmen's Terrace.
Pick the Elunite weapon that fits your build.
Druids: Mathrengyl teaches you Bear Form. Lessons Anew starts the Cure Poison quests.

steps.text: Train your new spells while you are in the city
Go back down to Rut'theran and fly to Auberdine
Go back down to Rut'theran and fly to Auberdine
Druids: Teleport to Moonglade and turn in Lessons Anew to Dendrite Starblaze
steps.tip: Druids: hearth to Auberdine afterwards; the falls sample is in Darkshore.

segments.title: Cliffspring River and the Tower of Althalaxx

steps.tip: The two wrecks lie offshore north of Auberdine. Swim straight to each lockbox; the murlocs nearby do not follow far.
Asterion at Bashal'Aran, on your way north-east.
A Beached Sea Creature lies on the shore north-west of Bashal'Aran. Click it to take the quest; it turns in to Gwennyth.
Fill the sample at the pool under the first waterfall of the Cliffspring River.
The Scaber Stalks and the Death Cap grow inside the cave behind the falls. The cave is full of Cliffspring mobs; pull carefully.
Druids: fill the sampler at the mouth of the same cave.
Balthule Shadowstrike hides in the trees near the Tower of Althalaxx.
Dark Strand Fanatics camp around the tower. The parchments drop from them.

steps.text: Speedrun: kill Dark Strand Fanatics around the tower until level 15
steps.speed: Remtravel's quest back in Auberdine needs level 15. The fanatics are already in front of you.

steps.tip: The next step is in Ashenvale. You pass Maestra's Post at the end of this pack.

steps.text: Turn in Buzzbox 411's fangs at Buzzbox 323 and take Buzzbox 525
steps.tip: Buzzbox 323 is by the Cliffspring River, west of the tower. The next box is far south, near the Grove.

steps.speed: Speedrun: hearth from the tower; the run back is long.

steps.tip: Onu is at the Grove of the Ancients in the south.
Skip The Blackwood Corrupted: it is a long multi-camp quest for the end of the zone.
Druids: Earthroot grows near Ameth'Aran and the Lunar Fungus is near the bear hills. Do both on your way south.
Hollee sends you to Prospector Remtravel at his dig in the south.
Murkdeep comes out at the murloc huts on the south coast after you kill a few waves of murlocs.

segments.title: The Grove of the Ancients and the Master's Glaive

steps.tip: The Blackwood camp is south of Auberdine. Kill the Pathfinders and Windtalkers around the bonfire.
Druids: Earthroot grows near Ameth'Aran, the Lunar Fungus near the bear hills.
Onu is the ancient in the Grove of the Ancients. Grove of the Ancients came from Fandral in Darnassus.
Remtravel's dig is on the coast west of the Grove. He wanders while he searches; stay close and kill what attacks him.
Beached Sea Creature on the beach north of Remtravel's dig.
Three more beached animals lie along the shore south of the dig. Click each as you pass.
Clear the murlocs at the huts on the beach until Murkdeep and his hound come out. Rest between waves.
Grizzled Thistle Bears roam the hills near Buzzbox 525.
The Scrying Bowl is in the Twilight camp at the Master's Glaive. Clear a path to it.
Forever quest from the Twilight Tome: a Peerless Eye from the Twilight cultists.
Twilight Disciples and Thugs at the Glaive both drop the eye.
Therylune is held at the Master's Glaive. She runs out by herself once you start the escort; you report to her sister in Ashenvale.
Back to Onu at the Grove. Mathystra Relics sends you to the naga ruins in the far north for the last loop of the zone.
Forever quest from Arbal next to Onu: 12 of each Stormscale naga at the same northern ruins.
Skip the next step: it sends you to Darnassus and then the Wetlands.
Thundris takes the Peerless Eye.
A Lost Master needs pelts from the Moonstalker Matriarchs in the far north, next to the naga ruins you visit next.
Druids: the Sickly Deer wander the woods just south-east of Auberdine. Use the salve on them.

steps.text: Druids: Teleport to Moonglade and turn in Curing the Sick

steps.tip: Druids: take the druid flight from Nighthaven to Rut'theran, learn Cure Poison from Mathrengyl, then fly back to Auberdine.

segments.title: Mathystra and the Road to Ashenvale

steps.tip: Gubber wants crab chunks from the big crawlers on the coast; you pass them on the way north.
Another turtle lies on the beach further west.
A Beached Sea Turtle lies on the north shore.
Reef and Encrusted Tide Crawlers line the beaches; the crab chunks drop from both.
The Den Mother is a level 18-19 bear with cubs, in the hills south of the river. Bring a friend or come back later.
The relics lie on the ground in the ruins of Mathystra. Grab them between naga pulls.
Myrmidons and Sorceresses are in the western half of the ruins, Warriors deeper east. Pull one at a time; the sorceresses net you.
Speedrun: the naga ruins are the best XP in the zone at this level. Kill everything on your way through the relics.
steps.speed: Speedrun: if Swelling Forces is not finished when the relics are, keep going anyway; the kills are worth it.

steps.tip: Moonstalker Matriarchs prowl the hills north of the naga ruins. They hit hard; fight them one at a time.

steps.text: Kill Stormscale Myrmidons in the ruins until level 17 (skip if you are already there)
steps.speed: Kerlonian's escort needs level 17. Grind only what you need here.

steps.tip: Volcor is hiding at the south end of the zone, near the Ashenvale border. You pass him on the way to Maestra's Post.

steps.text: Run south to the Grove and turn in Mathystra Relics to Onu and Swelling Forces to Arbal

steps.tip: Kerlonian Evershade sleeps at the Grove of the Ancients. Forever hotfix: he falls asleep less often and hands you the Horn of Awakening at the start; use it whenever he dozes off on the way to Ashenvale.
Volcor hides south of the Grove, near the road to Ashenvale. Skip his escape quest; it sends you back to Auberdine.
Sentinel Aynasha is on a hill south of the Grove, on the way to Ashenvale. Stay next to her and kill whatever attacks her.
Onaeya is at Maestra's Post, the first Alliance camp in northern Ashenvale.
Liladris Moonriver stands at Maestra's Post. Kerlonian runs ahead when you arrive.
Delgren the Purifier stands at Maestra's Post. The soul gem drops from the Dark Strand cultists in their camp nearby.
The Dark Strand camp is a short walk north-east of Maestra's Post. Pull the cultists one at a time.
Therysil is at the Shrine of Aessina, south-west of Maestra's Post.

steps.text: Take the boat from the Auberdine docks to Stormwind Harbor, then continue with Redridge Mountains 17-20
tip: New in Forever: a direct Auberdine to Stormwind boat replaces the old run through Wetlands. The dock position is unconfirmed; ask a dockhand if the pier differs.
Alternative: stay in Kalimdor and take the road to Astranaar in Ashenvale for 18-25.
